files:Metadata.description: Read only: written by graph_cli's extractors and refused for anyone else. A new version of an extractor updates the same record, `history` shows what earlier versions said. A failed or no longer applicable run is recorded as such, and then the attributes of a subclass are unset.
files:Metadata.summary: Derived metadata of one file, the current result of one extractor.

name.summary: Name of the part inside its record.

files:MetadataPart.description: Written only by graph_cli's extractors, together with its record: a new version of an extractor keeps the parts it still produces, adds new ones and retracts the ones it no longer produces.
files:MetadataPart.summary: An entity owned by one metadata record, such as a table of a database file.

confidence.summary: How strongly the claim is believed.

statement.summary: The asserted statement in plain language.

files:ColumnName.summary: The name of a column on one line, shortened to 200 characters.

provenance:Confidence.summary: How strongly a claim is believed.

guards.summary: A note needs a body before it is published.

transitions.summary: Take the note back for editing.

modules.summary: Minimal provenance relations shared by every graph.
Claims with their own evidence, confidence and validity period.
Stored files with where they came from, places inside them and derived metadata.
Derived metadata of PDF files, such as the page count.
Derived metadata of SQLite database files, such as their tables and views.
Notes about topics that cite their sources and assert claims.

core:derived_from.summary: The source was derived from a specific revision of the target.

core:retracts.summary: The source withdraws the target; created only by the retract operation.

core:source.summary: The target is where the information in the source came from.

core:supersedes.summary: The source replaces the target; created only by the supersede operation.

last_page.summary: Last page of the information when it spans several pages.

locator.summary: Place inside the file other than a page, such as a section, region or task number.

page.summary: Page where the information is, or where it starts.

files:from_file.summary: Information in the source entity was taken from the file.

files:metadata_of.summary: The metadata record describes the file.

files_sqlite:has_object.summary: A table or view that belongs to the database record.

nas:about.summary: The note is about the topic.

nas:broader.summary: The target topic is more general than the source topic.

locator.summary: Page, section or anchor within the source.

nas:cites.summary: The note uses information from the source.

provenance:contradicts.summary: The claim cannot be true together with the target claim.

rules.summary: Every source is cited by at least one note.
A published summary note cites at least one source.
A topic has notes or narrower topics.
